tracking: ADR-0333 (lane E15): API-only detection routes, awaiting the screens on #453

gaps.GET /v1/detection/rule-pack: reads the active detection rule pack, its version, digest and verification state
gaps.PUT /v1/detection/rule-pack: stores a new signed detection rule pack version (audited; a relaxation needs a settings_relax step-up)
gaps.GET /v1/detection/incidents: pages detection incidents, newest first, filtered by status
gaps.GET /v1/detection/incidents/:incidentId: one detection incident with its evidence chain (audit rows, row hashes, receipts)
gaps.PUT /v1/detection/incidents/:incidentId/: acknowledges or closes a detection incident (audited)
